#!/bin/bash
# collect SRC DEST: move every *.txt regular file directly inside SRC into DEST.
#  - only non-hidden names ending in lowercase ".txt"; directories are skipped
#  - names may contain spaces, glob characters, or start with a dash
#  - DEST/INDEX accumulates every name collect has ever moved into DEST:
#    one name per line, sorted bytewise (LC_ALL=C sort), no duplicates
#  - prints "moved N", N = number of files moved by this run
src=$1
dest=$2
mkdir -p -- "$dest" || exit 1
count=0
shopt -s nullglob
for f in "$src"/*.txt; do
  # A glob can also match directories (or symlinks to regular files).
  [[ -f "$f" && ! -L "$f" ]] || continue
  name=${f##*/}
  if mv -- "$f" "$dest/"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$name" >> "$dest/INDEX" || exit 1
    count=$((count + 1))
  else
    exit 1
  fi
done
# Ensure an empty run still leaves a usable, unchanged index.
: >> "$dest/INDEX" || exit 1
LC_ALL=C sort -u -o "$dest/INDEX" "$dest/INDEX" || exit 1
echo "moved $count"
EOF
chmod +x bin/collect
make test
cd /home/eval/media && mkdir -p 'build/t/in box' && touch 'build/t/in box/report final.txt' && bash -x bin/collect 'build/t/in box' 'build/t/out dir'; find build/t -maxdepth 3 -print; cat bin/collect
